skills.description: The player actively uses both takeout doubles to enter competitive auctions and penalty doubles to punish opponents' contracts.

skills.name: Preemptive Weak Two Openings
skills.description: Frequently opens with weak two bids in major suits to preempt opponents and define hand shape.

skills.name: Willingness to Sacrifice
skills.description: The player is willing to bid aggressively at a high level with weak hands to sacrifice against opponents' likely making contracts.

player_profiles.summary: Percario Giacomo demonstrates a clear preference for No Trump contracts, often using NT bids to describe balanced hands, even when holding a 5-card major. This player is also an aggressive competitor, willing to overcall in NT or major suits in contested auctions.

skills.name: Active competitive bidder
skills.description: The player actively enters competitive auctions with takeout doubles, suit overcalls, or by raising partner's suit, showing a willingness to fight for the contract.

skills.name: Aggressive NT overcaller
skills.description: The player frequently overcalls in No Trump, even with hands at the lower end of the point range or with a long suit, to show a balanced hand with stoppers.

skills.name: Employs invitational 2NT response
skills.description: The player uses 2NT as an invitational bid over partner's 1NT opening, aiming for a 3NT game.

skills.name: Opens 1NT with balanced strength
skills.description: The player consistently opens 1NT when holding a balanced hand within the standard 1NT opening range.

skills.name: Prefers NT rebids for balanced hands
skills.description: The player consistently uses NT rebids to describe balanced hands, even when holding a five-card major suit.

skills.name: Prioritizes 3NT over major game
skills.description: The player demonstrates a clear preference for bidding and playing in 3NT, even when a major suit game appears viable.

skills.name: Rebids 1NT with balanced shape
skills.description: The player makes a 1NT rebid after opening a minor and partner's major suit response, indicating a balanced hand.

player_profiles.summary: Guido Hopfenheit consistently demonstrates a strong preference for No Trump contracts, often prioritizing them over major-suit games. This is evident in their aggressive NT rebids in competitive auctions and their confident use of direct 1NT openings and raises. While assertive in NT bidding, the player tends to be conservative in defensive bidding, preferring to pass and defend rather than interfere.

skills.name: Aggressive NT Rebids/Responses
skills.description: The player often makes competitive No Trump bids or rebids, demonstrating a willingness to describe a balanced hand with stoppers in contested auctions.

skills.name: Conservative Defensive Bidding
skills.description: As a defender, the player rarely interferes with opponents' contracts once they have established a fit or game, preferring to pass and defend.

skills.name: Direct 1NT Opening/Raises
skills.description: The player and their partners consistently open 1NT with appropriate hands and raise directly to NT game, showing a standard and confident approach to balanced hand bidding.

skills.name: Opens 1NT with balanced hands
skills.description: The player consistently opens 1NT when holding a balanced hand within the standard 1NT range.

skills.name: Prioritizes NT over Major-Suit Games
skills.description: The player frequently chooses to bid or rebid No Trump contracts even when a major-suit fit is apparent or available, indicating a strong preference for NT scoring.

skills.name: Responds 1NT to major opening
skills.description: The player uses 1NT as a standard response to a major suit opening, indicating a balanced hand without support.

skills.name: Prioritizes NT over major game
skills.description: The player shows a strong preference for No Trump contracts, even when a major suit game might be available or suggested by partner.

player_profiles.summary: Margaux Kurek Beaulieu demonstrates a strong preference for NoTrump contracts, actively seeking them by opening 2NT or rebidding 1NT with balanced hands. She effectively uses standard NT conventions like Stayman to reach optimal NT games. Beyond NT, she is a competitive player, willing to make direct suit overcalls and even 1NT overcalls to enter the auction.

skills.name: Active competitive overcaller
skills.description: Frequently enters competitive auctions with overcalls or doubles, even with borderline hands.

skills.name: Consistent 1NT opening
skills.description: Player consistently opens 1NT with balanced hands within the standard point range (15-17 HCP).

skills.name: Prioritizes NT game contracts
skills.description: Shows a strong preference for reaching 3NT, even when alternative major suit games might be considered.

skills.name: Proactive NT contract seeker
skills.description: The player consistently opens or rebids to NoTrump, signaling a balanced hand and a desire to play in NT.

skills.name: Standard NT convention user
skills.description: The player employs common NT conventions like Stayman to find optimal NoTrump contracts.

skills.name: Balanced hand NT rebids
skills.description: Utilizes No Trump rebids to accurately describe a balanced hand, even after partner has bid a suit.

skills.name: Competitive NT overcaller
skills.description: The player makes 1NT overcalls in competitive auctions, showing a balanced hand and stoppers in the opponent's suit.

skills.name: Direct suit overcaller
skills.description: The player frequently makes direct overcalls in opponent's suits, indicating a desire to compete for the contract.
